en.headline: Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning issued at midday
en.dek: The Labour Department activated the Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning at 12.10pm as heat stress levels rose in parts of the territory under hot and humid conditions.
body: The Labour Department issued the Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning at 12.10pm on Tuesday, indicating that heat stress in some working environments had become quite high.

Employers are advised to follow the department’s guidelines on preventing heat stroke at work, including rearranging work schedules where reasonably practicable and providing appropriate rest breaks to reduce the risk to employees.

Workers who develop symptoms such as headache, dizziness, thirst or nausea should move to a cool place, drink water and inform their employer or supervisor immediately. The warning remains in force while the elevated heat stress persists.

zh.headline: 黃色工作暑熱警告中午生效
zh.dek: 勞工處下午12時10分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境的熱壓力頗高。
body: 勞工處今日（星期二）中午12時10分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境的熱壓力頗高。
僱主應參照勞工處的《預防工作時中暑指引》，在合理地切實可行的情況下採取防暑措施，包括重新編排工作時段及提供適當休息時間，減低僱員中暑風險。
僱員如出現頭痛、頭暈、口渴、噁心等熱疾病症狀，應立即到陰涼處休息和飲水，並通知僱主或主管。警告將於熱壓力水平回落後取消。
